# Billigere europæiske aktier - er de værd at samle op?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-02  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish Millionærklubben episode (Euroinvestor, Friday listener Q&A) with Michael Friis-Jørgensen (H.C. Andersen Capital) and Lars Svendsen (Svendsen & Tudborg). The talk centres on weakness in European stocks: French budget and debt worries, sharply rising yields and a sell-off in banks. Michael is buying bonds and is wary of AI hype. Lars expects a US crash that would send money to Europe as a safe haven. Stock-specific views: Michael is buying DSV and likes Zealand Pharma at its cash value. Lars sees Ambu as a long-term buy and is adding to Capital Tankers. Michael rejects Nike and prefers owners of data-centre buildings over GPU 'neocloud' operators.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 DSV — DSV | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Michael bought at 1400/1300/1200/1100; road issues solvable; consensus targets 1700-1900 if synergies arrive.

#### Reasoning

Guest Michael Friis-Jørgensen sees DSV's road-division problems as solvable, unlike Novo's pipeline problems. Other Schenker integration parts are going well. If synergies return, the stock would be worth around 1700-1900 at about 15x P/E. He expects a weak Q3 and accepts possible further downside. Lars Svendsen prefers waiting for an upturn near 1100.

#### Sell Triggers

- if road division recovery stalls beyond 2027
- if Schenker synergies fail to materialise
- if working capital strain persists

> *"Jeg købte den i 1400, 1300, 1200, og så købte jeg nogle flere i 1100."*

---

### 🟢 ZEAL — Zealand Pharma | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Price ~257 roughly covered by cash; glepaglutide EU recommendation overlooked.

#### Reasoning

Michael says that at current levels investors pay only for Zealand's cash pile, which has been a good entry point, even though the obesity data disappoint. Lars adds that the overlooked SBS drug glepaglutide has received a positive EMA committee recommendation and could be sold for a large sum.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further amylin/GLP-1 data disappoint
- if cash burn erodes cash floor

> *"Så de her 257, som den ligger på, handler lige rundt om nu det er attraktive niveauer. Ja, det mener jeg."*

---

### 🟢 AMBU-B — Ambu | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Lars sees 200 in 2-3 years from 65; turnaround done, new GI endoscopy products.

#### Reasoning

Lars Svendsen calls Ambu a long-term bet. He says the CEO fixed the company and launched GI endoscopy products. Ambu handles the US via its Mexico factory. Weariness among investors keeps the price low. His grandson bought at 63. Michael believes the stock is finding a bottom but lacks a catalyst.

#### Sell Triggers

- if GI product rollout fails
- if US/tariff issues hit margins

> *"Jeg mener, den vil koste 200 om 2-3 år."*

---

### ⛔ NKE — Nike | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Michael: guides negative growth, P/E 20 not cheap, turnaround unproven.

#### Reasoning

Michael rejects Nike after its report. It guides no top-line growth and relies on cost cuts. At a P/E around 20 it is not cheap after de-rating from 70. The turnaround is unproven after two years, and consumers spend only on strong new offers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if top-line growth returns
- if a new hit product line emerges

> *"Nej, men jeg skal ikke have Nike herfra."*

---

### 🟠 DLR — Digital Realty | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Michael would rather own data-centre buildings than operators; will start looking at DLR.

#### Reasoning

Michael expects about 80% annual deflation in data-centre hardware, which will hurt operators. The buildings themselves last 20-30 years, so low-leveraged building owners should do well. Leverage must be checked in case tenants like CoreWeave default.

#### Sell Triggers

- if leverage is high
- if major tenants default

> *"Og dem vil jeg faktisk begynde at kigge lidt på."*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Michael avoids neocloud operators exposed to chip deflation.

#### Reasoning

Michael expects compute prices to fall once bottlenecks ease, with each chip generation about 80% more efficient. Operators that depreciate chips over 6-8 years would be hit, and he says they could be bought cheaply in 2-3 years.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI compute demand keeps outstripping supply

> *"Jeg vil bare ikke eje dem, der smider indmad ind."*

---

### ⛔ NBIS — Nebius | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Grouped with neoclouds Michael would avoid relative to building owners.

#### Reasoning

This follows the same thesis as for CoreWeave: hardware deflation erodes the value of operators.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI compute demand keeps outstripping supply

> *"jeg vil hellere have dem end Neocloud, Nebios og Coreweaver"*

---

### 🟡 BMW — BMW | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars holds from 65, says very cheap but was early; China exposure weighs.

#### Reasoning

Lars considers German carmakers very cheap, with China fading out of their numbers. He owns BMW but admits he bought too early, and he suggests waiting for an upturn before adding. He is unsure about BMW's new cheaper-car strategy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new cost plan fails
- if margins stay near zero

> *"Så ja, de er billige. De er ved at være rigtig billige."*

---

### 🟡 VOW3 — Volkswagen | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars holds from 88 (now 68). Deutsche Bank sees upside to ~100; truck business adds value.

#### Reasoning

Lars holds Volkswagen at a loss and sees it as deeply cheap with value in its truck business. He cites a positive Deutsche Bank call (analyst opinion). He would wait for momentum before adding.

#### Sell Triggers

- if China losses deepen
- if Europe EV subsidies end

> *"Jeg tror, jeg har købt BMW på 65 og Folkevogn på 88"*

---

### 🟠 VOLCAR-B — Volvo Car | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Lars tempted at 15.5 SEK, ridiculously low, but waits for an upturn.

#### Reasoning

Lars says the valuation is extremely low, with a near-zero margin and about 710k cars a year. He sees normalised margins as a big upside but prefers to buy once the price starts rising.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins stay near zero

> *"jeg bliver jo fristet af Volvo"*

---

### 🟠 CADLR — Cadeler | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars wants back in but waits for a lower price; advises holders to accept the UK share swap.

#### Reasoning

Lars likes Cadeler's growth: a fleet of wind-installation vessels and an acquisition of a German foundation firm worth about €500m. He suspects a share issue is coming and waits for the price to drift lower. Holders should accept the redomiciliation exchange.

#### Sell Triggers

- if German acquisition not approved
- if large dilutive share issue

> *"Vi sidder og venter på, at den bliver billigere"*

---
